diagnosis.cause: Startup readiness race: child.pid is published by the spawned child before the owner necessarily publishes its post-Popen _record_pending state. The test snapshots bytes too early.
source_order: child_probe publishes child_started event before _run; it is not a readiness barrier
child immediately writes child.pid in its own process
owner publishes subprocess_running and pending_pgids only after Popen returns
test waits only for path existence before byte snapshot
diagnosis.heartbeat_claim: No periodic heartbeat loop exists in the inspected child-probe path. The CI difference is an authorized startup state transition, not a timestamp-only heartbeat.
diagnosis.ownership_semantics: EngineLock.owns requires acquired plus current process PID and token equality. Busy contender returns 73 immediately after failed mkdir and appends only lock_busy, before any cleanup finally block. Release retains pending-group/quiescence and ownership guards.
diagnosis.scope_limit: Static diagnosis and original CI evidence; no local reproduction or execution by diagnostician.

test_only_repair_proposal.method: Bounded source-state readiness barrier before taking original_owner raw bytes.
steps: Anchor initial owner PID/token from owner.json after its existing publication wait; require PID equals owner.pid.

After reading child_pid, poll owner.json with a monotonic deadline (e.g. 10 seconds), checking owner remains live. Decode each raw read and retain the exact same bytes only when PID/token match initial owner, checkpoint == subprocess_running, pending_pgids == [child_pid], and subprocess_quiescent is False.
Fail on identity mismatch, owner exit or barrier timeout; do not default, skip, or extend contention timeout.
Use the successful raw read as original_owner and retain the full byte-for-byte assertion after real CLI contender exits. No ignored fields or subset comparison.
test_only_repair_proposal.why_sufficient: In this source path, _record_pending atomically publishes the final startup state. While the real child sleeps and the owner waits in communicate, no additional owner update occurs until timeout, exit or interrupt. Observing that publication closes the specific proven startup window.
preserved_assertions: real runner CLI child-probe owner and lock-probe contender
full owner.json raw byte equality after contention
lock directory absent after owner cleanup
exact owner event sequence: lock_acquired, child_started, interrupted, cleanup_permitted, lock_released
forbidden_repairs: replace full bytes with a subset
mock the engine and claim real Maezo integration
modify product lock implementation without new product-bug evidence
